inputDocumentAssetID.description: A file assetID of a PDF document on which watermark has to be applied. For more details click here .

watermarkDocumentAssetID.description: A file assetID of a PDF document whose first page will be used as watermark. The output generated will retain the content and watermark of the first page. For more details click here .

notifiers.description: Specifies the notifiers to be invoked on the completion of job. To know more about notifiers, please see the documentation.

type.description: Specifies the notifier type. Currently supported value is "CALLBACK" only.

data.description: Specifies the data needed to invoke the notifier.

pageRangesWatermark.title: pageRanges
pageRangesWatermark.description: Specifies the page ranges on which watermark has to be applied in the input PDF file.

start.description: Start page of this page range. Page numbers are indexed from 1 to N.

end.description: End page of this page range. Page numbers are indexed from 1 to N.

watermarkappearance.title: appearance
watermarkappearance.description: Specifies the appearance parameters for watermark.

appearOnForeground.description: Placement of watermark on the page. Watermark will be either foreground or background on the page. Default is foreground.

opacity.description: Percentage value specifying watermark opacity. Specified as an Integer value from 0 to 100.
